app.reclamation_projects.title: Reclamation Projects
app.reclamation_projects.description: Reclamation projects and their stitched reconstructions
app.reclamation_projects.header_descript: Three documents per project become one 3D site solid, and that solid becomes the take-off.
app.reclamation_projects.projects_descri: Open a project to see its documents beside the reconstructed site.
app.reclamation_projects.empty_reconstru: Select a project to browse its reconstructions.
app.reclamation_projects.reconstruction_: Every stitch run, newest first. A revision is never overwritten, so an estimate always points at the geometry it was priced against.
app.reclamation_cost_matrix.title: Reclamation Cost Matrix
app.reclamation_cost_matrix.description: Unit rates per substrate and the estimates built from them
app.reclamation_cost_matrix.header_descr: Unit rates per substrate, the estimates built from them, and what each substrate measures.
app.reclamation_cost_matrix.unit_cost_ma: One rate per substrate, shared by every project. Rates never change a volume.
app.reclamation_cost_matrix.empty_estima: Select a project to browse its estimates.
app.reclamation_cost_matrix.estimates_de: Each estimate prices one reconstruction revision. Totals recompute on every save.
app.reclamation_cost_matrix.catalogue_de: The catalogue is fixed by the engine: a substrate exists because the solid can measure it. A rate row without a matching substrate is never priced, and a substrate without a rate row prices at zero and is listed on the estimate as a missing rate.
component.title: Title
component.priced_lines_description: Quantities come from the stitched solid; the levers above adjust what is priced.
component.doc_slot_floor_plan_hint: DXF site key plan, or a digitised plan JSON.
component.doc_slot_bathymetry_hint: XYZ or CSV soundings in the same frame as the plan.
component.doc_slot_cross_sections_hint: Authored DXF section sheet, or a digitised section JSON. A DWG must be exported to DXF first — every CAD application writes it.
component.rebuild_skipped: Inputs unchanged since the last run.
component.stitch_failed: The stitch failed — see the newest revision.
component.no_estimate_permission: You do not have permission to create an estimate.
component.attach_all_inputs: Attach all three reconstruction inputs to build the model. The stitch runs server-side as soon as the project is saved with a floor plan, a survey, and a section sheet.
component.all_attached_prompt: All three inputs are attached and nothing has been stitched yet — press
component.all_attached_prompt_tail: . Saving the project stitches it automatically; rows written by a seed or an import bypass that, so they need one build.
component.revision_failed: Revision {revision} did not produce a solid
component.build_for_sections: Build the model to plot its sections.
component.build_for_estimate: Build the model first — the estimate prices the solid, not the drawings.
component.no_solid_yet: No solid to show yet. Attach the floor plan, the bathymetric survey, and the section sheet; the reconstruction runs on save and the model appears when it lands.
component.design_simulation_description: Changes the solid, then re-measures it.
component.commercial_levers_hint: These change only what is priced, and recompute instantly. The solid does not move, so the measured quantities are untouched.
component.control_platform_level_note: Raise or lower the whole works. Every slope and width is preserved.
component.control_bed_level_note: Survey tolerance, post-dredge level, or settlement under the fill.
component.control_face_batter_note: Widen or steepen the seaward face; the platform keeps its width.
component.control_armour_thickness_note: Perpendicular to the face. Scales armour and geofabric directly.
component.control_sub_grade_note: Deepen or raise every trench drawn on the section.
component.control_sand_loss_note: Washout and bulking on hydraulic placement.
component.control_dredged_loss_note: Placement loss on dredged and excavated material.
component.control_perimeter_margin_note: Allowance for an uneven reclaim edge, on every perimeter line.
component.control_pvd_area_note: Share of the platform receiving vertical drains.
component.control_pvd_spacing_note: Triangular grid pitch. Drain count scales with 1/s².
component.line_hint_unpriced: No {currency} rate in the cost matrix, so this line cannot be priced.
component.saving_explainer: Saving records the commercial levers against this reconstruction revision and re-prices server-side. A design simulation is exploratory: to keep it, change the project and re-stitch.
component.manual_take_off_hint: Work a plan, a survey, and a section do not contain — the rate depends on method, material, or a structural drawing rather than on shape. The total above excludes all of it.
component.reconstruction_inputs_hint: All three are required. Elevations come from the sections, plan extents from the floor plan, and the existing bed from the survey. Edit the project record to attach or replace one.
component.further_documents_hint: Extra section sheets and surveys that also feed the model. Another perimeter section is the most useful thing you can add: it replaces a stretch of interpolation with measurement. Saving one re-runs the stitch.
component.tender_reference_hint: Filed against the project and never parsed: tender returns, correspondence, permits, method statements. Nothing here can change a quantity.
component.layers_hint: Switch a layer off to look inside the solid. Visibility changes the live scene only — nothing is recalculated and no volume moves.
component.no_checks_flagged: No document conflicts or extraction errors were flagged.
component.assumptions_not_supplied: Not directly supplied by the source documents
component.assumptions_verify: These assumptions affect the model and its calculated quantities. Verify or replace them before relying on the result.
component.layer_read_heading: How each section layer was read
component.layer_read_note: A layer read as internal is excluded from the finished surface. Correct any of these with profileLayers in the project overrides.
component.no_section_geometry: No section geometry was decoded from the drawing.
component.drawing_geometry_hint: Authored CAD entities only. Horizontal and vertical metres use one common scale; no bathymetry, material shading, or interpolated model geometry is added here.
component.legacy_profile_hint: This reconstruction came from a legacy profile table, not a CAD drawing. It can be plotted at equal axis scale but cannot prove that drawing entities were identified correctly.
component.legacy_source_warning: Source is {source}. Replace it with the authored cross-section drawing before treating this reconstruction as verified.
component.dwg_warning: This revision was stitched from a native DWG, which the reconstruction no longer reads. The geometry below stands, but rebuilding the project needs the same sheet exported to DXF.
component.section_aria: Section {name}, drawn with equal horizontal and vertical scale
component.section_points: {points} decoded points · true scale (1:1 horizontal to vertical)
recon.substrate.rock_armor.label: Rock armour
recon.substrate.rock_armor.note: Blanket on the seaward face: thickness × true sloped area.
recon.substrate.geofabric.label: Geofabric
recon.substrate.geofabric.note: One layer under the armour, 1:1 with the sloped face area.
recon.substrate.dredged_rock.label: Dredged rock foundation
recon.substrate.dredged_rock.note: Foundation rock, dug to the invert drawn on the section.
recon.substrate.sand_key.label: Sand key
recon.substrate.sand_key.note: Trench under the bund, dug to the invert drawn on the section.
recon.substrate.sand_fill.label: Sand fill
recon.substrate.sand_fill.note: Bund sand plus platform fill above the material change level.
recon.substrate.dredged_fill.label: Dredged and excavated fill
recon.substrate.dredged_fill.note: Platform fill below the material change level.
recon.substrate.pvd.label: PVD soil improvement
recon.substrate.pvd.note: Drain length from the treated area, grid spacing, and mean fill depth.
recon.manual.caisson_concrete.label: Caisson or quay wall concrete
recon.manual.caisson_concrete.why: A vertical face is modelled as retained fill. Concrete volume, reinforcement, casting yard, and float-out are structural work the section does not dimension.
recon.manual.caisson_founding.label: Caisson founding trench and bedding
recon.manual.caisson_founding.why: The trench a caisson is founded in is below the drawn toe and is not part of the fill solid.
recon.manual.dredging_disposal.label: Dredging and disposal
recon.manual.dredging_disposal.why: Excavation is measured and reported, but disposal route, haul distance, and licensing drive the rate — none of which is in the documents.
recon.manual.temporary_works.label: Temporary works
recon.manual.temporary_works.why: Bunds, silt curtains, working platforms, and discharge pontoons are means and methods, not permanent geometry.
recon.manual.surcharge.label: Surcharge and settlement allowance
recon.manual.surcharge.why: Extra fill placed to pre-load the platform depends on a settlement analysis, not on the finished level.
recon.manual.services.label: Services, drainage, and pavements
recon.manual.services.why: Everything above the finished platform level is outside the reclamation solid.
recon.manual.monitoring.label: Instrumentation and monitoring
recon.manual.monitoring.why: Settlement plates, piezometers, and survey control are a programme cost.
recon.surface.armor.label: Rock armour face
recon.surface.armor.note: The rock armour blanket on the seaward face, drawn at the thickness the section dimensions, measured perpendicular to the slope.
recon.surface.crest.label: Perimeter bund crest
recon.surface.crest.note: The perimeter bund crest between the armoured face and the platform behind it.
recon.surface.platform.label: Reclaimed platform
recon.surface.platform.note: The finished reclaimed surface, at the platform level the section gives.
recon.surface.skirt.label: Fill against the existing bed
recon.surface.skirt.note: The face of the fill where it meets the existing ground — the closing wall between the design surface and the surveyed bed.
recon.surface.subgrade.label: Excavated below the bed
recon.surface.subgrade.note: Ground excavated below the existing bed before any fill was placed: the key trenches the section drops beneath the seabed, which anchor the works rather than letting them rest on it.
recon.surface.seabed.label: Surveyed bed
recon.surface.seabed.note: The surveyed bed, drawn at the survey's own resolution rather than decimated.
recon.surface.structure.label: Pre-existing embankment
recon.surface.structure.note: A pre-existing structure standing inside the footprint, which displaces new fill.
recon.surface.existing_land.label: Existing land
recon.surface.existing_land.note: Land already in place adjoining the works.
recon.surface.lagoon.label: Containment pond
recon.surface.lagoon.note: A containment pond still open inside the bund, carrying no fill.
recon.surface.context.label: Adjacent and future works
recon.surface.context.note: Adjacent and future works, drawn for orientation and not measured.
recon.surface.sea.label: Water plane
recon.surface.sea.note: Still water level, for reference against Chart Datum.
recon.cost.no_rate_for: The cost matrix has no {currency} rate for: {names}.
recon.cost.measured_not_priced: Those materials are measured but not priced, so the total understates the works.
recon.cost.rate_in_other_currency: A rate exists for {names} in another currency; this workspace holds no exchange rates, so it was not applied.
recon.cost.add_missing_rates: Add the missing rates in the cost matrix and re-price.
